newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod still weak on expected tax hit.
newsitem.headline: Pernod still weak on expected tax hit.

text.p: Shares in drinks company Pernod-Ricard continued to weaken on Friday, following a forecast by its managing director that the French spirits market would shrink next year, market sources said.

"It's typical of a stock hit by taxation. No-one wants to touch it as you risk getting stuck in growth problems," said one source. Pernod Ricard was down 2.76 percent at 278.20 francs, on volume of 59,280 shares at 1555 GMT.
Managing director Thierry Jacquillat told a conference on Wednesday that an announced tax increase would shrink the spirits market by two to three percent in 1997. mbl/pnt
